title: encopella tenuifolia
intro: Encopella tenuifolia, commonly known as Himalayan sage, is a plant species that has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine. The health benefits of Encopella tenuifolia include its use in treating various health conditions, such as digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of Encopella tenuifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
